scope: Authenticated read-only mobile POS catalogue and category navigation. Login/session and record-list reads only; no sale was added or finalized.

checks.name: Runtime identity
checks.result: Frontend and backend both reported the runtime SHA above, which contains the candidate source commit.

checks.result: At 390px the category view opened as a 794px fixed panel. Cart closed the panel and restored the register layout.

checks.name: Responsive browser health
